naac796ca54.headline: Middle East geopolitical tensions cause world oil prices to plunge
naac796ca54.summary: The UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and Egypt decided on Monday to cut diplomatic relations with Qatar. They accused the Gulf state of supporting terrorism and interfering in their domestic affairs.
naac796ca54.why: Qatar is a major Gulf energy exporter, and political rifts among Gulf producers raise uncertainty over regional oil and gas supply.
naac796ca54.why_moved: Oil prices fell as the Gulf states announced a diplomatic rupture with Qatar, raising regional geopolitical tensions.

nfc87dcf6f4.headline: Cargill, the American giant that had to say goodbye to its mega-business in Los Llanos
nfc87dcf6f4.summary: Complaints about environmental abuse led Corporinoquia to make a surprise visit. The visit put the business of the US agribusiness giant Cargill in the Llanos region at risk.
nfc87dcf6f4.why: Cargill is a large private US agribusiness and food company with global supply chains in commodities such as grains and oilseeds.
